problems.explain: The amplitude is half the range: (8 − 4) ÷ 2 = 2 ft. (The whole range, 4, is twice the amplitude.) So 2.

prompt.v: At a harbor, high tide is 8 ft at 3:00 a.m. and the next low tide, 4 ft, comes 6 hours later. Modeling the depth as a sinusoid, what is the midline depth, in feet?

problems.text: tide: high 8 ft, low 4, half cycle 6 h; want midline
problems.explain: The midline is halfway between high and low: (8 + 4) ÷ 2 = 6 ft. (Not the range: the average of the two depths.) So 6.

prompt.v: At a harbor, high tide is 8 ft at 2:00 a.m. and the next low tide, 4 ft, comes 6.25 hours later. Modeling the depth as a sinusoid, what is the period, in hours?

problems.text: tide: high 8 ft, low 4, half cycle 6.25 h; want period
problems.explain: High tide to low tide is half a cycle, 6.25 hours, so a full cycle is 2 × 6.25 = 12.5 hours. (Back to high tide takes another 6.25 hours.) So 12.5 hours.
